    lengths = case['lengths']
    scores = case['scores']
    budget = case['budget']
    n = len(lengths)
    dp = [[0.0] * (budget + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        len_i = lengths[i-1]
        score_i = scores[i-1]
        for w in range(budget + 1):
            if len_i <= w:
                dp[i][w] = max(dp[i-1][w], dp[i-1][w-len_i] + score_i)
            else:
                dp[i][w] = dp[i-1][w]
    selected = []
    w = budget
    for i in range(n, 0, -1):
        if dp[i][w] != dp[i-1][w]:
            selected.append(i-1)
            w -= lengths[i-1]
    selected.reverse()
    tokens_used = sum(lengths[i] for i in selected)
    total_score = dp[n][budget]
    return {'selected_indices': selected, 'tokens_used': tokens_used, 'total_score': total_score}"}
